# JanusMCP

> JanusMCP is a local, open-source multi-account tool broker for AI agents, available
> directly from the CLI or through MCP (Model Context Protocol).
> Add your credentials once and switch identity — the same service (Supabase, GitHub,
> Slack…) with many accounts — without disconnecting and reconnecting, from any LLM
> client (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor). Tokens stay in your OS keychain and never
> pass through the model context; only the active account's tools are exposed, so the
> context stays small.

## What it does
- One credential broker, every account, from the CLI or MCP — no reconnect and no re-login.
- Profiles group a client's accounts across services (e.g. Supabase + GitHub of "Client A") and activate them together (`janus_use_profile`).
- One-shot cross-account calls without switching the active account (`janus_with_account`).
- Code-execution mode: agents with shell access can use the CLI directly — `janusmcp tools` (compact list), `janusmcp schema <tool>` (one schema on demand), `janusmcp call <tool>` (invoke) — so no bulk tool definitions are loaded upfront.
- Machine-safe CLI: `janusmcp call <tool> --json`, opt-in `--timeout`, stable exit codes, and `janusmcp use <account|profile>`.
- Local-first: stdio + Streamable HTTP transports; OS-keychain vault; OAuth (PKCE) with persistent, auto-refreshing tokens.
- Works with any MCP client and is listed on the official MCP Registry.

## How it is different
MCP gateways/proxies aggregate different servers behind one endpoint. JanusMCP solves the orthogonal problem: many identities for the SAME service, without saturating the model's context, fully local. It is a credential-aware broker, not a flat aggregator.

## Install
- npm: `npx @bayway/janusmcp serve`
- Homebrew (macOS/Linux): `brew install bayway/janusmcp/janusmcp`
- Scoop (Windows): `scoop bucket add janusmcp https://github.com/bayway/scoop-janusmcp && scoop install janusmcp`
- Docker: `docker run --rm -p 7332:7332 ghcr.io/bayway/janusmcp:latest`
